title: Edge-region Dedicated Capacity onboarding and release notes orchestration
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Launch Dedicated capacity in the new edge region (apac-edge-1) with a new instance family (rwd-gpu-e2) and an accompanying "flex-plus" reservation plan. This ticket coordinates cross-team GTM tasks, draft and finalize release notes, verify billing SKU definitions, and run a staged rollout that minimizes customer disruption.

Scope and deliverables:
- Finalize instance SKU names and billing metadata with Finance/Billing.
- Coordinate eng readiness for runtime kernels and autoscaling for rwd-gpu-e2 in apac-edge-1.
- Publish staged release notes with sections for Developers, Platform Admins, and Partners.
- Prepare Console feature flag (edge-capacity-2025.12) and per-tenant enablement flow.
- Create partner onboarding checklist and migration guidance for Reservation "flex-plus" plan.
- Define monitoring/alert runbooks and SLAs for the first 30 days.

Acceptance criteria:
- Billing SKUs approved (finance sign-off) and visible in Sandbox billing flow.
- Runtime team confirms kernel/quantization profile passed perf tests at P95 latency targets.
- Release notes published and reviewed by Legal, Security, and Docs.
- Console flag implemented and internal beta enabled for 3 partners.
- Telemetry dashboards with pre-configured alerts live in Grafana/NewRelic.

Rollout plan (staged):
1) Internal alpha (eng + SE) — 2025-11-24 to validate infra & onboarding.
2) Partner beta (3 partners) — 2025-11-30 to 2025-12-06.
3) Gradual public GA (region open; reservation purchasable) — Target 2025-12-12.

Rollback and fallback policy:
- If P95 latency > 2x target for 2 consecutive hours, automatic traffic reroute to eu-west-1 compatible instance family.
- Manual reservation pause and quota rollback handled by Capacity Ops with documented playbook.

Notes on communication and audience segmentation:
- Developer-facing release notes should include API compatibility, sample SDK flags, and migration snippets for reservation changes.
- Admin-facing release notes should cover quota controls, billing implications, and audit log entries.
- Partner comms must include a one-page migration timeline and contact matrix for escalations.
comments: 2025-11-05 — Sync with Runtime (ENG-3412): rwd-gpu-e2 passes end-to-end shader/kernel selection tests but needs an additional KV-cache tweak for long context (>16k) workloads. Runtime suggests a soft-limit flag in Console for first two weeks.

2025-11-07 — Finance review: Preliminary SKU names approved (RWD-E2-XS, RWD-E2-S, RWD-E2-M). Finance requested explicit refund/credit wording for reservation downgrades in release notes. Added action to draft billing FAQ.

2025-11-10 — Security signoff kickoff: Security requested HSM/KMS verification steps for Private deployments using apac-edge-1. Added security_review_required=true and assigned follow-up to ENG-11911.

2025-11-12 — Docs review: Draft release notes uploaded to Confluence (link below). Docs asks for two developer examples: SDK flag usage and terraform snippet for reservation creation. Assigned to Miguel for completion by 11/18.

2025-11-15 — GTM comms: Growth and Sales flagged partner list for beta (Partner A/B/C). PR for partner onboarding email template created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/182. Waiting on legal review for contract addendum.
2025-11-17 — PM triage: Updated rollout dates after Runtime requested an extra week of partner beta. New GA target 2025-12-12. Confirmed Console feature flag build is on track.
